name: patchai
description: Finds security vulnerabilities in Python code and fixes them with the PatchAI model, with checks and human approval.

patchai.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the local PatchAI server.

patchai.model.description: Model used to write fixes. Leave empty to use the server's default model. Use 'PatchAI: Select Model' to pick one.

patchai.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used by 'PatchAI: Start PatchAI Server'. Leave empty to use the repository's .venv (or 'python' if there is none). A relative path (for example .venv/Scripts/python.exe) is resolved against the server folder.

patchai.serverDir.description: Folder the server is started in (the PatchAI repository root). Leave empty to use the folder that contains this extension.

patchai.scanOnSave.description: Scan the workspace again after a Python file is saved.
